name: Pin collection
promptTemplate: Using only the subject and interests explicitly provided for this request, create a set of 8 hyper real illustrated enamel pins in a 4x5 image. 1 medium pin is a portrait of me, 1 small pin is a word that describes me, 1 small pin is my name. The style is bold, flat, bright colors, eye catching. If you don’t know enough about me yet, pull cues from the photo.
promptHints: Photo of a person in the foreground with personal details in the background, or while participating in a hobby
